svg.title: The U-curve does not end where the textbook stops drawing
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The U-curve does not end where the textbook stops drawing” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Bias falling and variance rising combine into a thick U-shaped total test-error curve that spikes to a test MSE of 17.8 at the interpolation threshold and then descends a second time to 0.0569, all sitting above a dashed irreducible noise floor of 0.0625, with three small polynomial fits below of which the degree-fifteen snake is crossed out at coefficient norm 6342, and an L2 circle touched mid-arc beside an L1 diamond touched exactly at its corner.
svg.text: The U-curve does not end where the textbook stops drawing
draw it from memory, then compare
